### 1 of 1. 1 spec in doc/specs says a newer spec fully replaces it

### What was found
One spec is affected: `doc/specs/retired-widget.md`. A note in its title block, on line 3, says `doc/specs/widget.md` fully replaces it. No other card involves this file.

### Why it matters
A design document whose own note says another document fully replaces it is out of date and can mislead readers. The housekeeping rules for specs flag such documents for removal, in `reference/base-rules.md`.

### What happens if you accept
`doc/specs/retired-widget.md` is deleted in a separate working copy of the repository. You receive one pull request against the default branch, already pushed. Your main copy's tracked files stay unchanged. Git history keeps the deleted text. `README.md` also mentions this spec. That file sits outside the spec and plan folders, so it would point to a missing document. That outside mention is the reason to keep the spec.

Pick one:
1. [ ] Delete - remove the listed specs; build this class in its own worktree and open its own pushed PR against the default branch; leave the primary's tracked files unchanged.
2. [ ] Keep - leave them in the spec folder [recommended]
